name: desi-claude-plugin
description: Official Claude plugin for Desi Language AI and GlobalTalk AI: high-precision neural translation across 100+ global world languages and 22 official Indic languages, 3-tier cultural honorifics (Aap/Tum/Tu), AI writing enhancement, multilingual glossaries, and layout-preserving document translation.

translation.description: Neural text translation across 100+ world languages and 22 official Indic languages with formality control

writing_improvement.description: Desi Write: Style rephrasing (business, academic, casual, simple) and grammar/spelling corrections

glossary_access.description: Custom bilingual and multilingual terminology enforcement and dictionary lookups

document_translation.description: Layout-preserving asynchronous translation of DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, TXT, and HTML files

indic_honorifics.description: 3-tier cultural honorifics (Aap/Tum/Tu), respectful suffixes (-जी/-గారు/-அவர்கள்), and phonetic transliteration
